03 / What to expect

You tell us about the work.
We build the website.

A few clear steps. You review the site as we go.

The details make the difference.
01

Tell us about your business.

What kind of painting do you do? Which towns do you work in? What jobs would you like more of? Your current website and job photos give us a place to start.

02

We put the site together.

We write and design the pages around your services, service area, and photos. You review the work and tell us what needs to change.

03

Review it before launch.

We check the pages, links, forms, and phone layout with you. We’ll agree on the launch details before the site goes live.

Let’s talk about your website ↗

05 / Website questions

Questions about
a new website.

How much will my website cost?

The price depends on the pages and features you need. We’ll learn about your painting business, outline the work, and give you a written price before you decide.

How long does it take to build?

It depends on the pages, photos, and time for feedback. We’ll agree on a schedule before we start.

What do you need from me?

A few details about your services and service area, plus photos of your finished work. If anything is missing, we’ll let you know.

Can I keep my website address?

Usually, yes. Your domain is your website address. We’ll check how it’s set up, including any email connected to it, before making a change.

Who owns the website after launch?

We’ll explain who owns the site, how hosting works, and what updates or support are included before you decide.

Will a new website bring me more jobs?

A better website can help homeowners see your work and contact you. It can’t promise more jobs; that also depends on who finds you, your area, and your reputation.
